mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the unemployment rate threshold (UNRATE > 0.5%) in three-month rolling average triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting improved labor market confidence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite UNRATE crossing 0.5% threshold, or t-test p-value > 0.05 in 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate decline (FEDFUNDS) and GDP growth (GDPC1) over 60 days signals a dual expansionary pressure, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to correlate with the 60-day FEDFUNDS-GDPC1 interaction rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL index below 2% signals cooling inflationary pressures, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate a potential rate hike.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite CPIAUCSL falling below 2% in the regime, or IC < 0.03 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained exceedance of GDP growth (GDPC1) above 18,000 Billions of Chained 2017 Dollars in a 3-month rolling average triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting robust demand-driven market optimism.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite GDPC1 exceeding 18,000, or p-value > 0.05 in t-test against baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and industrial production (INDPRO) above their 5-year averages over 20 days signals a dual expansionary pressure, reinforcing equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to correlate with the FEDFUNDS-INDPRO interaction rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in both GDP growth (GDPC1) above 18,000 Billions and payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 140,000 in a 60-day window signals robust demand and labor market strength, amplifying S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to correlate with the GDPC1-PAYEMS interaction rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: In a contraction phase regime, a sustained rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4% and a decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% over 5 days signals tightening monetary policy and labor market weakness, prompting negative S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate economic slowdown.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite contraction signals, or IC > 0.05 over 1-year window.
